blockingFindings.finding: Actual five-view evidence showed jagged neckline, sleeve and leg-opening boundaries inherited from polygon-center selection.
The rectangular shoulder bridge produced broad wing-like underarm geometry.
Front and back lower panels remained visibly pointed and uneven.
The sampled back drape still floated as detached side fins instead of reading as folded cloth.
Blender final save completed without orphan Shape Key errors, but the legacy gate rejected the truthful eight-object construction because it incorrectly required at least fourteen mesh objects.
The build exited before the pose stage, so tracked pose images and fit-audit data were stale and were not accepted as v17 evidence.

currentRevisionRequirements: Require the evaluated source to be subdivided twice with interpolated UVs and weights.
Require shoulders and sleeves to be selected from interpolated arm weights without a rectangular shoulder bridge.
Require neckline, wrist and leg openings to be locally smoothed and reprojected to the evaluated source at controlled clearance.
Inspect all five directional renders generated from v18.
Inspect neutral, arms-up, arm-cross, crouch, sit and prone renders generated from v18.
Require one connected primary shell with no more than five boundary loops.
Require no underarm wings, exposed inner-arm strips, waist fins or pointed crotch panels.
Require the folded hood roll to follow the upper back without detached fins.
Require the current-revision fit audit and images to agree before PASS.
